description: This file defines the Document class within the Opencart	oSystem	oLibrary namespace. It manages webpage document metadata such as title, description, keywords, links, styles, scripts, and meta tags, providing methods to set and retrieve these properties.

classes.name: Document
classes.description: Class representing an HTML document's metadata components, including title, description, keywords, links, styles, scripts, and meta tags.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the document.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Retrieves the current title of the document.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the meta description of the document.

methods.name: addLink
methods.description: Adds a link element with specified href and rel attributes.

methods.name: addStyle
methods.description: Adds a stylesheet link with optional media attribute.

methods.name: addScript
methods.description: Adds a script element with specified href.

methods.name: addMeta
methods.description: Adds a meta tag with specified attributes (name, property, content, media, etc).
